C0110.title: Man Arrested for Operating Over 1,000 Phones to Manipulate Views and Comments
C0110.summary: In August 2023, police in Chongqing apprehended a man in a rented apartment who had set up a device farm using over a thousand mobile phones to mass-control accounts for fake view generation and comment manipulation. The operation simulated large volumes of fraudulent user traffic to fabricate engagement metrics, constituting typical display fraud and view inflation.
